messages:
alex: Quick check — planning the release cut next week; aiming to sync versions across API, SDKs, and Console. Runtime will be rolled as v2.4.0-rc1. Cutoff: Mon 2026-03-22 16:00 PT. Who's owning canary steps?
jess: API PR ready: https://github.com/redwood/api/pull/2401. Unit + integ tests pass. Need eyes on the broken example in the docs.
srini: Runtime PR here: https://github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/1002 — includes kv-cache perf tweak and minor scheduling fix. I want to run runtime canary first.
marta: SDKs need a patch bump to 1.13.0 because we add an optional retry config. Node PR: https://github.com/redwood/sdk-node/pull/429, Py PR: https://github.com/redwood/sdk-python/pull/237. Both include compatibility tests.
ryan: Console change is a small package.json update. PR: https://github.com/redwood/console/pull/189 — depends on sdk-node published package and runtime metrics endpoint.
alex: Proposed canary sequence:
1) runtime RC -> publish docker tag runtime:v2.4.0-rc1 and run internal canary
2) api canary against runtime RC
3) sdk canaries (node & py) against api canary
4) console canary last
Cool? Also we need owners for tagging + publishing after cut.
jess: I'll run API canary + smoke tests and check docs examples.
srini: I'll tag and kick off runtime canary. Plan snippet:
```bash
git checkout release/v2.4
git merge --no-ff runtime/kv-sched-fix
git tag -a v2.4.0-rc1 -m "RC1: kv-cache perf + scheduler"
./ci/publish-docker.sh runtime v2.4.0-rc1
```
ci-bot: runtime CI for PR #1002 passed — 14/14 jobs green :white_check_mark:
release-bot: Deploy window Mon 03/22 16:00 PT — pushes to release/* blocked after cutoff.
marta: SDK owners: after api canary passes, we'll bump to 1.13.0, update CHANGELOG.md with the opt-in retry note and link the runtime RC.
ryan: I'll wait for sdk-node to be published to npm then point console to 1.13.0 and run frontend smoke.
alex: Final publish flow (after meta tag):
- runtime: promote rc1 -> v2.4.0 (docker push)
- api: merge release branch -> tag v1.13.0
- sdk: publish node & python (1.13.0)
- console: publish frontend (1.13.0)
Reply with :thumbsup: for the step you own.
jess: :thumbsup: (API canary + tag)
srini: :thumbsup: (runtime tagging + canary)
marta: :thumbsup: (sdk publish)
ryan: :thumbsup: (console publish)
alex: Quick checklist to include in PRs before cut:
- CHANGELOG entry + link
- compatibility note (runtime RC required)
- smoke tests and publish owner
- example snippets updated
If you want changelog phrasing help ping me.
jess: fixing docs example now, will push in ~15m.
srini: runtime canary started on internal fleet. Will post results.
ci-bot: runtime canary smoke succeeded — 5/5 checks green.
srini: Canary looks stable. Hold to promote until after cutoff.
alex: OK leaving this thread open for any last-minute cut blockers. If none by cutoff I'll tag the meta-release and proceed. :shipit:
